title: The bird in the mirror
logline: The Legacy's rear-view mirror with the road going away in it and the bird on the mirror's housing, and at the glass's edge the sliver of an eye — 2021's page, five years on, with the bird added and nothing else changed.

panels.composition: Close on a station wagon's rear-view mirror: the coastal road receding in it, the small rainbow bird perched on the mirror's housing, and at the glass's edge a sliver of a graying man's face, one eye.
